$Comment: The Emerald Wilds campaign's front door, and the first quest a new player is handed.
AutoAccept starts it the moment the onboarding chain's gather_the_basics is finished, so a
player never has to find it. It has one step, the report-back hand-in below: a TURN_IN with a
blank Target asks for no items, only that the player stands in front of Ranger Wren and says
hello. Wren's own conversation completes it from her intro line.
The _Wilds folder is what puts the wilds_ in front of this file's id, so the file can be named
for the beat rather than for the questline. Rename the folder and every id under it changes,
The starter kit is granted as item rewards rather than as /give commands, so a full bag holds
the payout back instead of dropping it on the floor.
